output.captionSafeArea: nothing that matters within 5% of any edge (54 px sides, 96 px top and bottom); captions in the bottom band, 82% to 93% of frame height (y 1574 to 1786), per knowledge/craft/12-frame-quality.md; the studio's 9:16 plan check (tools/checks/capture_relayout.mjs) must keep the acted-on thing and pointer inside the safe area on every frame
output.colour: BT.709 SDR delivery (primaries, transfer and matrix tagged bt709, limited range, yuv420p); stills are untagged sRGB and are treated as BT.709 SDR

loudness.note: master.sh's own pass/fail only fails a peak above -0.5 dBTP; the required gate for this card is -1 dBTP, so check the measured 'after' value by hand.

output.keylessPreview: renders with no network, no API key and no paid provider: captions only, synth/CC0 kit sounds, no TTS
checks: tools/checks smoothness.py: no jumps or judder
audio after master.sh: -15 to -13 LUFS and true peak at or below -1 dBTP
every sound has a cause on screen; no two of a kind within 0.3 s

soundPlan.source: library/sounds/kit.json slot IDs (brand files in brands/tulvo/sounds win where present; say which slots came from the library in the hand-over)

bed.note: exactly the length of the slice; low under the whole film so captions-only silence does not sound dead; has a known fan-hum doubt, listen first

music.use: optional; off by default for a UGC feel; if on, duck under any voice

hook: impact-soft (impact/thud-01) at 0.0 on the first line landing
demo: soft-click (click/mouse-tap-01) on each pointer click, matched to cursor.json
toast-pop (pop/soft-pop-01) when the New hover opens
cta: offer-sting (chime/sting-bright-synth-04) as the offer line lands

soundPlan.levelRule: effects at a third to two thirds of the voice level (07-sound.md); with no voice, hold effects about 6 dB below the bed-plus-music peak and verify with master.sh
